verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single pricing-page line, "AI Automatically Syncs Emails, Events, and Contacts." It indicates automatic email sync into the CRM but gives no detail on providers, sync direction, or record matching. Missing for 10: named Gmail and Outlook connectors, confirmation that sync is two-way, documentation of auto-logging emails to the correct Lead/Contact/Opportunity records, setup docs for ops users, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
